prose: Prepare for a journey of truly epic proportions, to the beginning and end of all things. In this nearly four hour mythological marathon, Episode 9 of Inner Whirled takes us through the esoteric symbolism of the deluge, its ubiquitous presence throughout the world, and how the great flood and the cosmogenesis are secretly the same story. You'll never look at Noah the same way again, because this presentation will conclusively prove his identity as Kronos, Brahma, Hades, and all the myriad creator, destroyer and preserver gods of antiquity.
